purpose: Section 35: apply the certification's own pass-gate checklist against 30-certification-findings.json and deliver exactly one of the three allowed verdict strings.

passGateChecklist.requirement: Zero BLOCKER findings across all 16 certified trust boundaries
Every P0/P1 from the historical defect ledger is CLOSED_AND_CERTIFIED or INTENTIONALLY_DEFERRED_NON_BLOCKING or OBSOLETE_FALSE_POSITIVE - none OPEN_BLOCKER
passGateChecklist.evidence: P1-10 and P1-11 are both OPEN_BLOCKER (01-historical-defect-ledger.json).

passGateChecklist.requirement: Zero production code changes made during this certification phase
passGateChecklist.evidence: 02-production-freeze-proof.json - mechanical git diff against the starting commit confirms zero changes to lib/, app/, or prisma/schema.prisma.

passGateChecklist.requirement: Required quality gates (tsc/eslint/build) are clean or baseline-consistent
passGateChecklist.evidence: 29-quality-gates.json - all three baseline-consistent, zero new errors.

passGateChecklist.requirement: Test suite passes or every failure is explicitly diagnosed and classified
passGateChecklist.evidence: 29-quality-gates.json - 2042/2043 tests pass; the 1 failure is fully diagnosed as an out-of-certification-scope, pre-existing (byte-identical code since the phase's starting commit) environmental anomaly unrelated to any certified trust boundary.

passGateChecklist.requirement: Every finding was independently verified against real data/real code, not replayed from a prior phase's own self-report
passGateChecklist.evidence: Each of the 6 auditors built its own new adversarial tests/scripts against real Postgres and real source fixtures rather than trusting prior phases' claims - documented per-section in 03-28*.json.

passGateChecklist.requirement: Every finding is classified by severity (BLOCKER/MAJOR_NON_BLOCKING/MINOR/INFORMATIONAL), with no severity downgraded because a fix looked easy
passGateChecklist.evidence: 30-certification-findings.json; multiple auditors explicitly noted declining to downgrade (e.g. 05-supersession-certification.json's SUPER-3 reasoning, 09-source-trace-certification.json's S11-F1 reasoning).

explicitStatement: Headroom's foundation, exactly as it now exists, does NOT yet deserve to be trusted enough to proceed to Phase 3F.2 (second unseen-package validation) or Phase 4 (Contract Computation). 11 independently-confirmed, de-duplicated BLOCKER findings exist across 5 of the 16 certified trust boundaries (E supersession awareness, H claim identity, J independent verification, K safe-failure wiring and cross-module composition, L provenance/source trace), plus a cross-cutting architecture-invariant violation. Two of the four residual defects this phase's own immediately-preceding phase (3F.1.5.R) reported as 'genuinely remediated' - P1-10 (rank-stack corruption) and P1-11 (supersession awareness) - are independently re-classified OPEN_BLOCKER after direct re-inspection against real source text and real call-graph tracing, in both cases because the prior phase's own regression evidence, while accurate as far as it went, did not establish what its own remediation charter actually required (a fix inert everywhere the signal is actually consumed downstream is not a fix; a narrower-than-intended detection pattern that still reproduces the exact original mechanism in real data is not a fix). This is not a wholesale indictment of the foundation - 11 of the 16 trust boundaries (B, C, D, F, I, and the fully-certified portions of G, K's model half, M, N, O) independently PASS or CERTIFY_WITH_DISCLOSED_NON_BLOCKING_GAPS, and the explicit claim-level safe-failure architecture itself (its data model, its NO_SILENT_MATERIAL_FAILURE compliance, its review-event signal quality) is independently confirmed sound - but it is not wired into anything a real customer's document ever reaches, which is itself one of the 11 BLOCKERs.
burdenOfProofApplication: This phase's own framing was explicit: the burden of proof has flipped from 'is this feature demonstrated' to 'does the foundation, exactly as it now exists, deserve to be trusted?' Under that framing, a foundation with 11 independently-reproduced BLOCKER findings - several of which are the SAME classes of defect (silent claim disappearance, structural misattachment, identity collision) that motivated Phase 3F.1.5.R's own safe-failure architecture in the first place, now shown to still occur through paths that architecture does not yet cover - does not meet the bar. This verdict does not represent a regression introduced by this phase (zero production changes were made, per 02-production-freeze-proof.json) - it represents this phase successfully doing the job it was chartered to do: independently verifying rather than trusting prior phases' own self-assessment, and reporting what it found without downgrading, softening, or silently repairing any of it.
notCertifiedReminder: Per this phase's own scope (Section 1), this certification never assessed and makes no claim about: financial data accuracy, covenant arithmetic, simulation correctness, dashboard/UI correctness, or CFO-readiness. This verdict concerns the CONTRACT-MODEL FOUNDATION only (structural/semantic/amendment/safe-failure/persistence layers).
